motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

welcome.purpose: Centered empty-conversation heading, 26px medium beside the Android in-app W.

body.purpose: WinKuSans aliases unchanged Noto Sans SC; local 16px root and accompanying OFL license.

answer.purpose: Unbranded assistant prose at 15px/26px with the shared Android text-document and mathematics treatments.

code.purpose: Preserve shared Android code typography, syntax colors and wrap behavior.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Connect or save a model using the Android neutral primary-button role.
components.css: .ds-primary{font:500 14px/1.6 WinKuSans,'Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI',sans-serif;background:var(--action-fill,#17171a);color:var(--on-action,#fff);border:0;border-radius:11px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 18px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--foreground,#17171a)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Learning card

结合图像、公式与操作理解概念。
components.css: .ds-card{--surface:var(--background,#f7f7f9);--primary:var(--accent,#0e8a4a);min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--foreground,#17171a);border:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);border-radius:20px;font:16px/1.5 WinKuSans,'Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 12px 4px 18px}.ds-card-head>svg{color:var(--primary,#0b6e3b)}.ds-card-head h2{margin:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal}.ds-card-description{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted,#55555e);margin:0;padding:0 18px 12px}.ds-card-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);padding:4px 12px}.ds-card-footer button{font:14px/1.6 WinKuSans,'Microsoft YaHei UI','Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#55555e);min-height:48px;padding:10px 8px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease,color .16s ease}.ds-card-footer button:hover,.ds-card-footer button:active{background:var(--hover,#17171a14)}.ds-card-footer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card-footer button{transition:none}}

components.name: Bottom composer
components.description: Current flat R28 composer with permission, mode and polish toolbar; runtime menus and voice entry are implemented separately.
components.html: 选择模型
components.css: .ds-composer{max-width:800px;border:1px solid var(--border,#17171a1a);background:var(--composer,#fff);border-radius:28px;padding:14px 14px 10px;box-shadow:none;font:16px/1.6 WinKuSans, "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", sans-serif}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:68px;max-height:180px;resize:none;outline:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--foreground,#17171a);font:16px/24px WinKuSans, "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft YaHei", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:0 0 12px;caret-color:var(--primary,#0b6e3b)}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-composer-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;gap:10px;color:var(--muted,#55555e);font-size:13px}.ds-composer-toolbar button{display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-add{width:30px;height:30px;background:var(--selector,#eeeef2);color:var(--foreground,#17171a)}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-send{width:36px;height:36px;margin-left:auto;background:var(--accent,#0e8a4a);color:#fff}.ds-send:hover{filter:brightness(.92)}.ds-composer-toolbar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#0b6e3b);outline-offset:3px}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-permission{height:30px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--soft,#e3f3ea);color:var(--primary,#0b6e3b)}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-mode{background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#55555e)}.ds-composer-toolbar .ds-polish{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;padding:5px;background:var(--brand,#0e8a4a);color:#fff}.ds-composer-toolbar button:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-composer-toolbar button:active{filter:brightness(.9)}

narrative.overview:
This app extends WinKu's established Android learning interface: neutral grey and chalk surfaces, ink text, an emerald W, rounded groups and a conversation-first hierarchy. Locally bundled Noto Sans SC gives Chinese and Latin interface text a consistent sans-serif voice. Shared learning content keeps its separate mathematics, code and content-color conventions. This is an app-scoped implementation record, preserving the Android identity.

Android is the visual authority. `scripts/sync-android-design.mjs` generates Android colors, in-app mark, launcher artwork, icon paths and provider presets. Styles load shared learning CSS, desktop CSS, generated Android roles, then `mobile-parity.css`. The final layer supplies the current font and Android-shaped controls. `MobileUI.tsx` supplies repeated controls and `MobilePages.tsx` settings pages. `SURFACE.md` records the Windows composition; `../../PRODUCT.md` remains product context.

The build remains unfinished. The existing independent finish review has disposition FIX. This refresh reconciles intentional token drift without rerunning the detector or granting release approval. Current code restores the acknowledgement-gated risk dialog, Android switch geometry and expanded mode editor, with final review pending. Extension hierarchy/plugin management, skill imports, MCP authentication, language selection and busy-send queue/steer remain unresolved. Do not describe every subpage as nearly identical to Android.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral surfaces with emerald identity and content accents.
Android-derived colors, marks, icons, grouped settings and composer.
Bundled Chinese and Latin sans text, textbook mathematics and code.
Shared learning components retain their Android visual vocabulary.

rules.name: The Android Role Rule
rules.body: Preserve separate roles for neutral primary actions, readable chrome links, business accents and the W mark. Learning content keeps its scoped role overrides; do not flatten every scope into one primary color.

rules.name: The Study Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the separate typography of prose, equations and code instead of flattening study material into interface labels.

rules.name: The Current Evidence Rule
rules.body: Document current code and review limits separately; a token refresh does not establish that missing portable Android flows are complete.

dos: Do preserve the Android neutral/chalk world and emerald W when extending Windows.
Do synchronize shared colors, marks, icons and provider presets from Android sources.
Do use bundled WinKuSans for interface text and preserve separate prose, mathematics and code treatments.
Do retain R20 groups, the R28 composer and the compact Android switch geometry.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible names, acknowledgement gates and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain vector, raster and bundled-font provenance when shipping.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity with a new desktop brand or display-font theme.
Don't promote chart, explanation or syntax colors into general app chrome.
Don't collapse chrome and learning-content scopes into one action palette.
Don't turn this sidebar/composer arrangement into a universal composition rule.
Don't populate the reserved Tools entry with invented student features.
Don't claim release approval or completed extension/language/busy-send parity from this documentation refresh.
